---
title: "Exacto"
subtitle: "EXacto Accurate Characterization of Transcriptomes and genOmes"
---

Exacto is a long-read toolkit for mutant proteoform prediction. Using long-read DNA and RNA sequencing data, Exacto:

* Identifies somatic and germline DNA variants.
* Performs variant-aware assembly of full-length transcripts.
* Identifies RNA variants.
* Links DNA and RNA variants.
* Translates transcripts into predicted proteoforms with amino acid-level annotations of DNA and RNA variants.
* Identifies mutant peptides against a reference proteome.

## Quick Start

### 1. Install

```bash
conda create -n exacto python=3.10
conda activate exacto
pip install pysam==0.23.0
conda install -c conda-forge rust==1.95.0
conda install -c conda-forge clangdev=21.1.8
conda install -c anaconda pandas==2.2.3
conda install -c conda-forge polars==1.26.0
conda install -c conda-forge pyarrow==19.0.1
export LIBCLANG_PATH=$CONDA_PREFIX/lib
pip install exacto-<version>.tar.gz --verbose
```

Download the latest release from
[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/pirl-unc/exacto/releases). A Docker
image is also available on
[Docker Hub](https://hub.docker.com/r/ajslee/exacto).

### 2. See What's Available

```bash
exacto --help
```

Or browse the [Commands](cli/index.qmd) reference for every subcommand
and its options.

### 3. Pipelines

Exacto supports pipelines for mutant proteoform prediction, variant-aware transcriptome assembly, and individualized genome / transcriptome graph construction.
See [Pipelines](pipelines/index.qmd) for more.

## How Exacto is Organized

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-4}
### Variant-aware transcriptome assembly
`cluster-rna-reads`, `correct-rna-reads` and `determine-rna-consensus` turn long RNA reads into one
consensus sequence per transcript; `stitch-reference-transcripts` restores degraded ends;
`quantify-rna-abundances` estimates abundances.
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
### DNA / RNA variant calling
`call-germline-dna-vars` and `call-somatic-dna-vars` call DNA variants from long-read alignments;
`call-rna-transcript-vars` calls RNA variants and transcript structures on assembled
transcripts; `annotate-vars` adds gene-level context.
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
### DNA + RNA variant integration
`integrate-vars` links each RNA variant to the DNA variants that explain it.
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
### Variant-aware translation
`translate-transcripts` translates transcripts to proteoforms that record, per amino acid, the
variants they came from; `translate-seqs` translates plain sequences.
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
### Mutant peptide calling
`call-peptide-vars` calls the mutant peptides of the proteoforms against a reference proteome.
:::

::: {.g-col-4}
### Individualized genome / transcriptome graphs
`build-genome-var-graph` and `build-transcriptome-var-graph` produce personalized graphs that encode
the sample's variants alongside the linear reference.
:::

:::

## Dependencies

* python (>=3.10)
* rust (1.95.0 tested)
* libclang (>=9.0, build-time only — required by `bindgen` for the abPOA bindings)
* numpy (>=1.22.3)
* pandas (>=2.0.3)
* polars (>=1.12.0)
* pyarrow (>=18.0.0)
* pysam (>=0.22.0)
* pytz (>=2024.1)
